recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中的淋巴瘤細胞比旁邊的正色母紅血球大好幾倍，核呈分葉、摺疊或凹陷，染色質細緻並見核仁，胞質淡藍到嗜鹼性且帶小空泡，符合 DLBCL 侵犯骨髓。
features: Very large atypical lymphoid cells, several times the size of adjacent normoblasts
Markedly irregular nuclei: folded, lobulated and indented contours
Open, finely granular chromatin with small indistinct nucleoli
Moderate pale-blue to basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuoles
Background orthochromatic normoblasts and a small dark lymphocyte-like cell
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows large atypical lymphoid cells with markedly irregular, folded and lobulated nuclei, open finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli, and moderate amounts of pale-blue to basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. Adjacent orthochromatic normoblasts highlight their large size. No granules or Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes also have folded nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm but show fine azurophilic granules, nonspecific esterase positivity and CD14/CD64 expression.
ATLL cells show polylobated 'flower' nuclei with condensed chromatin, CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype and HTLV-1 positivity.
Megakaryocytic cells show cytoplasmic blebs or granular cytoplasm and are CD41/CD61-positive.
